notes.title: Trading Cards And More
notes.content:
📢 Thank You, Climber Animals Together Community! 🎉

Dear Players,

We are excited to announce that Climber Animals Together has reached 10,000 climbers! Thank you all for your support.

You can now drop collectible cards and get unique backgrounds and emoticons from the points shop.

Your support and feedback help us make Climber Animals Together even better. Thanks again for being with us on this journey.

Have fun and good luck climbing!

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
[h1]Major Update 1.2 - 27.03.2024 [/h1]



[list]
[*] The map has been extended and new areas have been added (760M>1060M).
[*] 4 new emotes have been added.
[*] Leaderboard has been reset.
[*] Screen shake is now an optional setting.
[*] Main menu has been reorganized.
[*] Fixed invisibility issue when entering the lobby
[*] Fixed the issue of starting on small screen when the game is first opened
[/list]
